sections.title: Housing and the shared environment: meaning and form
body: Goal: Understand housing information and report a practical problem with the necessary details.
Core vocabulary: en tvättstuga, ett soprum, en felanmälan. Key phrases: Hissen repareras på tisdag. · Lampan i trapphuset fungerar inte. · Kan ni kontrollera ventilationen?

Housing notices often use the passive -s form: Hissen repareras. For your own report, state the location, problem and effect, then request an action. Use compound nouns such as tvättstuga and soprum as one word.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.en: The lift will be repaired on Tuesday.
The light in the stairwell does not work.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Kan ni kontrollera ventilationen?” is a formal service request way to express “Could you check the ventilation?”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What must the resident do? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Who should contact the property service? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Make a fault report by phone. Give your address, identify the exact place, describe the problem and say when it began. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a concise message to the housing company about a broken shared-space fixture and request a response. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The problem affects the laundry room rather than your apartment, and other residents can still use the room.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
assignment.model: Hissen repareras på tisdag. Lampan i trapphuset fungerar inte. Kan ni kontrollera ventilationen?
